notes:
Improvements:

- Dorcel TV now performs a planned InputStream Adaptive handoff shortly before the signed one-hour token expires, using the already prepared warm-standby stream instead of waiting for HTTP 403 retries and EOF recovery.
- The planned Dorcel handoff remains isolated to Dorcel TV; all other Adult-TV-Channels.com streams keep their existing playback behaviour.

Bugfixes:

- Replaces Status-tab Kodi radio buttons with normal highlighted buttons so Kodi can no longer toggle a control and the Python click handler immediately toggle it back.
- Individual Site selections now remain active correctly, while All available Sites stays the guaranteed fallback when no specific Site remains selected.
- Skip channels after 3 failed checks now stays enabled independently of Auto Check and is correctly applied to manual Channel Status checks.
